Maya (PM): Quick thread: EU opt-in rollout for ranking v2. Need low-risk plan, sticky assignments, and exemptions for 3 VIPs. Suggestions?

Ishaan (Eng): Recommend: shadow 24h -> 5% sticky -> 25% sticky -> 100% flip. Use assignment_store with TTL 30d so sessions persist. Fallback: if candidate pool error >0.7% -> route new requests to control.

Ruth (SRE): Add auto-evict: if p95 > baseline +100ms for 2 windows OR queue depth >150 for 10m then evict. Alert to #eng-oncall + #product. Also require cache-warm metric >65% before >5%->25% ramp.

Ana (Solutions): I'll add admin endpoints: POST /admin/flags/eu_rank_v2/exempt and /optin and Console row with audit trail. ETA tomorrow.

Zoe (CS): VIPs want 48h pre-ramp notice and manual opt-in. I'll handle comms and consent.

deploy-bot: Scheduled shadow start eu_rank_v2 at 2026-04-06T09:00Z (invoked by Ishaan).

Maya (PM): Action items: Ishaan -> rollout config + sticky implementation; Ruth -> runbook + alerts; Ana -> exemptions API + docs; Zoe -> customer comms. Check back in 24h here.
